items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: You had Joe Oliver Day, you had Manuel Perez, you had Kimmer, you had Icon White.

ctx.x: I'm talking about, say, in 1910 when you were just really coming out, who would be in the street playing really tunk music?
Well, we had a good men up in there. You had Joe Oliver Day, you had Manuel Perez, you had Kimmer, you had Icon White. Oh, I couldn't get you the names of all of them.
Yeah, but I mean, non-reading bands, ones that didn't read at all, wouldn't they have those?
